title: In two trials, AI tutors lifted overall scores by 0.31 SD (Nigeria) and 0.63 SD (Harvard)
subtitle: Effect on learning in two randomised trials, in standard deviations (SD)
categories: Harvard physics: AI tutor vs active-learning class
Nigeria, after-school AI tutoring: overall assessment
notes: The two studies tested different things on different learners, so compare their sizes with care.
Harvard: crossover RCT, 194 students; the authors call 0.63 SD an underestimate because of a ceiling effect.
Nigeria: World Bank working paper, 654 students in nine schools; the digital-skills effect is significant only at p < 0.1.

sources.label: Kestin et al. (2025), AI tutoring outperforms in-class active learning, Scientific Reports
